test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT?

options.text: A balance sheet is prepared at a particular point of time and not for a particular period.
Those assets which cannot be seen or touched and have no volume but have value are called tangible assets.
A balance sheet is a summary of balances of those ledger accounts which have not been closed by transfer to the trading account and the profit and loss account.
A balance sheet shows the nature and the value of assets and the nature and the amount of liabilities at a given date.

solution:
The incorrect statement is **Those assets which cannot be seen or touched and have no volume but have value are called tangible assets. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Those assets which cannot be seen or touched and have no volume but have value are called tangible assets:**

 
 
• This statement is incorrect. Assets that cannot be seen or touched and have no physical presence but have value are called intangible assets, not tangible assets.
 
• Intangible assets include intellectual property, goodwill, patents, trademarks, and copyrights.
 
• Tangible assets, on the other hand, are physical assets that can be seen and touched, such as machinery, buildings, and inventory.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A balance sheet is prepared at a particular point of time and not for a particular period:**

 
 
• This is correct. A balance sheet provides a snapshot of a company's financial position at a specific point in time, showing the assets, liabilities, and shareholders' equity.
 
 
 
• **A balance sheet is a summary of balances of those ledger accounts which have not been closed by transfer to the trading account and the profit and loss account:**
 
 
• This is correct. The balance sheet summarizes the remaining balances after the revenue and expense accounts have been closed to the trading and profit and loss accounts.
 
 
 
• **A balance sheet shows the nature and the value of assets and the nature and the amount of liabilities at a given date:**
 
 
• This is correct. The balance sheet details the types and values of a company's assets and liabilities at a specific date, providing insight into the company's financial stability.
